# authwise_realm_config (Data Source)

A realm's config: provisioning, recovery, bot protection, SMS and the default locale. The authentication policy is not part of it: declare an `authwise_realm_authentication_policy`. Builds the RealmConfig message and exposes its protojson encoding as `json`, the value `authwise_realm.config` takes. Makes no API calls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "authwise_realm_config" "this" {
  default_locale = "en"

  provisioning = {
    self_signup                = true
    require_email_verification = true
  }

  recovery = {
    self_service_reset = true
    reset_ttl          = "30m"
  }

  bot_protection = {
    mode       = "ALWAYS"
    provider   = "TURNSTILE"
    site_key   = "0x4AAAAAAA"
    secret_ref = { name = authwise_secret.turnstile.name }
  }
}

resource "authwise_realm" "this" {
  display_name = "Customers"
  config       = data.authwise_realm_config.this.json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bot_protection` (Attributes) The challenge an anonymous request must pass before kit sends mail or SMS or creates an account. Absent is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bot_protection))
- `default_locale` (String) The BCP 47 tag the realm writes to its people in when nothing better is known. Unset is no realm default, which is not the same as `en`.
- `provisioning` (Attributes) How an account comes to exist in the realm. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioning))
- `recovery` (Attributes) Whether a person may reset a forgotten password from the login page, and how long the link lives. Absent is off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recovery))
- `sms` (Attributes) Where the realm will send an SMS, and how many per destination prefix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sms))

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The protojson encoding of RealmConfig, for `authwise_realm.config`.

<a id="nestedatt--bot_protection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bot_protection`

Optional:

- `endpoint_name` (String) The endpoint serving AuthwiseBotCheckService, for `ENDPOINT`.
- `fail_mode` (String)
- `mode` (String) `OFF` (the default), `ALWAYS`, or `ADAPTIVE`, which kit refuses for now.
- `provider` (String)
- `refuse_disposable_signup` (Boolean)
- `secret_ref` (Attributes) The provider's secret key, for `TURNSTILE` and `HCAPTCHA`, as `{ name = authwise_secret.x.name }`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bot_protection--secret_ref))
- `site_key` (String) The provider's public key, rendered by the login UI.
- `timeout` (String) A Go duration string, e.g. `90s`, `15m`, `12h`.

<a id="nestedatt--bot_protection--secret_ref"></a>

Optional:

- `name` (String)
